jobs.description_text: The Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine (LKCMedicine) trains doctors who put patients at the centre of their exemplary care. The School, which offers both undergraduate and graduate programmes, is named after local philanthropist Tan Sri Dato Lee Kong Chian. Established in 2010 by Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, in partnership with Imperial College London, LKCMedicine aims to be a model for innovative medical education and a centre for transformative research. The School’s primary clinical partner is the National Healthcare Group, a leader in public healthcare recognised for the quality of its medical expertise, facilities and teaching. The School is transitioning to an NTU medical school ahead of the 2028 successful conclusion of the NTU-Imperial partnership to set up a Joint Medical School. In August 2024, we welcomed our first intake of the NTU MBBS programme, that has been recently enhanced to include themes like precision medicine and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare, with an expanded scope in the medical humanities. Graduates from the five-year undergraduate medical degree programme will have a strong understanding of the scientific basis of medicine, with an emphasis on technology, data science and the humanities. The Neuroscience and Artificial Intelligence Research (Nair) group at Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine, NTU, is seeking a Research Assistant/Associate to contribute to interdisciplinary research at the intersection of neuroscience and artificial intelligence. The role is open to experimental and computational candidates, including those who wish to contribute through combined approaches to neural and behavioural data. Key Responsibilities: Collect and analyse research data Develop and document experimental and/or computational workflows Contribute to presentations, grants and publications Participate in lab meetings and collaborative research Key Competencies and Requirements: Bachelor’s (Research Assistant) or Master’s (Research Associate) degree in a relevant discipline Experience or strong interest in neuroscience, AI, machine learning, data analysis or experimental research Programming and quantitative skills are desirable Good written and oral communication skills, ability to work independently and collaboratively Interdisciplinary backgrounds are welcome We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. About the Team

We sit on the front lines of OKX's security and compliance mission. Our charter is to build the flexible, scalable, and intelligent AI systems that detect and prevent identity fraud, account takeover, and large-scale organized abuse — in real time and at the scale of a global financial platform. We own the core identity-risk capabilities that decide, millions of times a day, whether an account can be trusted: identity trust signals, behavioral risk modeling, relationship and cluster intelligence, and face, liveness and document verification. We work shoulder-to-shoulder with Product, Risk, Compliance, and Engineering to turn the hardest adversarial problems in crypto into production-grade defenses that protect good users and the open financial system.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and own key identity-risk and trust models at OKX. You will build models that combine identity verification results, device and geo data, and user behavior into trust and risk signals, and use graph and clustering methods to uncover organized, industrialized fraud. This is an end-to-end, research-to-production role: you will own algorithms in your domain and ship models into real-money, high-risk, large-scale production environments.
You will be a hands-on technical contributor who works closely with Product, Risk, and Compliance, and who helps raise the technical bar of the team. Your domains span:
  • Identity trust & risk modeling — fusing verification scores, device, geo, and behavioral data into identity-quality and trust signals.
  • Cluster & relationship intelligence — graph and clustering methods to identify account farms, mass registration, and coordinated attacks.
  • Behavioral risk modeling — behavioral features and sequence models for account takeover and abnormal-session detection.
  • Biometric & multimodal signals — face embeddings, liveness/anti-spoofing, DeepFake and injection defense, document forgery and AIGC detection, used as inputs to identity trust and the risk layer.
  • AI agents — applying agentic AI to scale investigation, detection, and operational defense.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build identity trust & risk models: Design and ship coarse-to-fine risk models that fuse face/liveness/document verification scores, device, IP and geo signals, and behavioral data, for high-concurrency real-time decisioning.
  • Uncover organized fraud with graph & clustering: Build entity graphs across accounts, devices, faces, documents and templates, and apply community detection, clustering, and GNN methods to detect fraud rings and large-scale abuse.
  • Develop behavioral features & sequence models: Engineer real-time and offline behavioral features, and build sequence models to detect account takeover, bot/script behavior, and abnormal sessions.
  • Leverage biometric & multimodal signals: Turn biometric features (face embeddings, face quality, liveness and anti-spoofing results) and document-forgery and DeepFake signals into reliable identity-trust inputs for risk decisions, including biometric similarity for cross-account linkage and duplicate-identity detection. Work with the face, liveness, and document teams, or build models yourself.
  • Drive execution & collaboration: Deliver measurable results while managing ambiguity; partner with backend, product, infrastructure, risk, and compliance teams to integrate models into the production decision chain. Own metric definitions, the balance between false positives and missed fraud, pass rate, monitoring, and drift handling.
  • Advance applied R&D: Experiment with graph learning, multimodal fusion, and AI agents; stay current with academic and industry advances and translate them into practical defenses.
  • Raise the technical bar: Contribute to design reviews, share applied-AI best practices, and mentor junior engineers.

What We Look For

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building risk-control, fraud-detection, or identity-trust models, including significant experience deploying ML systems into production.
  • Graph & clustering expertise: Experience applying graph mining, community detection, clustering, or GNN methods to fraud or abuse detection.
  • Behavioral modeling: Solid experience with behavioral feature engineering and sequence modeling, including real-time feature pipelines.
  • Deep AI/ML expertise: Strong proficiency with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow, and solid experience with production ML systems.
  • Strong technical & coding skills: Strong coding ability (e.g., Python, SQL) and the system-level thinking to design end-to-end solutions with high availability and low latency.
  • Adversarial mindset: Understanding of how fraudsters adapt, and how to evaluate and iterate defenses against evolving attacks.
  • Collaboration: Strong communication skills, with experience working across engineering, product, and risk teams.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in identity verification, KYC/KYB, AML, face-payment or payment risk control, or biometric security.
  • Hands-on experience with face recognition, liveness/anti-spoofing, OCR, document parsing, fake-ID detection, or media forensics.
  • Experience with graph databases or graph computing (e.g., Neo4j, GraphX) and real-time graph features.
  • Knowledge of data and AI/ML infrastructure (e.g., Spark, Flink, Kafka, Airflow, Snowflake).
  • Familiarity with MLOps best practices: monitoring, retraining, and continuous improvement of production models.
  • Experience with LLMs and AI agents.
  • Experience working in fast-paced technology companies or security-critical environments.
  • Research publications, patents, or open-source contributions in relevant AI fields.


Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

Responsibilities:

  • Architect, develop and maintain frontend solutions with performance, scalability and continuous integration in mind.
  • Leverage AI coding agents and tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks across the team's workflow.
  • Design and maintain reusable AI extensions like custom skills, MCP servers, and tool integrations.
  • Develop and maintain reusable component libraries, plugins, and shared modules consumed across multiple products to reduce duplication and improve consistency.
  • Drive improvements to developer experience and engineering velocity - build tooling, CI/CD pipelines, code generation, and AI-assisted workflow automation.
  • Continuously improve product quality and user experience by working with backend engineers, PMs and designers to translate complex business workflows into intuitive interfaces.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's in Computer Science / Engineering / or related STEM field.
  • Solid production experience with React, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, etc.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools and agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) - comfortable using AI to augment development workflows, generate code, and solve problems faster.
  • Exposure to or strong interest in building AI-powered features - chat interfaces, LLM integrations, agent orchestration, or conversational UX.
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), custom skill/tool authoring, or AI agent extensibility patterns - understanding how to connect AI agents to external systems and codify workflows into reusable automations is a strong plus.
  • Understand of front-end packaging workflow and familiarity with standard development tools such as npm, webpack, git, etc.
  • Understanding of cross-browser compatibility challenges and the ability to diagnose and resolve rendering/behavioral differences across environments.

jobs.description_text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About The Team

Our Trading Product Group leads the design of all the products on OKX's derivatives trading exchange, including spot trading, spot margin, futures, leveraged tokens, trading options etc.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • AI Agent Review & Escalation - Review AI agent outputs across risk monitoring workflows — assess findings for accuracy, identify false positives, and escalate risk events through the appropriate channels with clear, well-documented rationale.
  • Risk Patrol Operation - Operate AI-assisted investigation workflows covering key risk metrics. Verify agent reasoning, identify analytical gaps, and ensure the quality output of investigations.
  • Market Abuse Investigation - Review AI-surfaced signals related to suspected market abuse, assess the validity, and escalate to the appropriate team with a structured findings report.
  • SOP Development & Agent Skill Authorship - Translate frontline risk experience into structured SOPs and agent skill sets. Identify blind spots in current detection logic, document edge cases, and collaborate with the Product team to continuously improve automated coverage.
  • Risk System Quality Review - Conduct regular reviews of agent performance — assessing output quality, surfacing systematic errors, and proposing refinements. Serve as a quality gate between automated risk outputs and business-level decisions.
  • Cross-Functional Risk Coordination - Communicate escalated risk findings clearly to Product, Compliance, Legal, and Operations teams. Ensure AI-generated intelligence is accurately interpreted and translated into actionable, well-documented recommendations.

What We Look For In You

  • 3+ years in trading risk, ideally at a crypto exchange or derivatives venue.
  • Deep knowledge of attack vectors: pump-and-dump, wash trading, liquidation suicide attacks, Sybil patterns, flash crashes.
  • Strong data intuition — Able to QA AI-generated analysis, spot anomalies in outputs, and challenge agent conclusions.
  • Comfort operating in an AI-augmented workflow: prompting agents, reading structured outputs, making final calls under time pressure.
  • Excellent judgment in ambiguous, high-pressure situations — You decide, the agent advises.
  • Cross-functional collaboration skills; able to work with PMs, engineers, and compliance.

Nice-To-Haves

  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based tools, SQL, or Python — Enough to validate AI-generated queries.
  • Personal trading experience or financial risk certification (FRM/CFA).
  • Mandarin proficiency for collaboration with technical teams.
  • Experience writing or refining risk SOPs or runbooks.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!
